name: AlGhafa-Arabic-LLM-Benchmark-Translated-10percent
description: A 10% translated subset of the AlGhafa Arabic LLM benchmark intended to evaluate Arabic-language LLM performance across a range of NLP tasks. It covers question answering, classification, and generation-style items to measure language understanding and reasoning in Arabic models. The subset enables faster experimentation and comparative evaluation when full-scale translation is not available.
evaluation_method: accuracy for closed tasks and task-specific automatic metrics (e.g., F1) with human evaluation for open-ended responses
general_score_metric: accuracy / task-specific metrics aggregated into a composite score
reputation: Part of the AlGhafa family of Arabic benchmarks; useful for Arabic LLM evaluation but less widely adopted than some larger multilingual suites.
